Every judged source file was read at the head sha through the API (`package.json` and barrel of both packages, `DetailView.tsx`, `recordPageProvenance.ts`, `renderers/record-details.tsx`, `renderers/recordBinding.tsx`, `RecordMetaFooter.tsx`, `RecordDetailView.tsx`, `PagePreview.tsx`, `PageBlockCanvas.tsx`, `studio-canvas-preview.tsx`, `SchemaRenderer.tsx`, `RecordContext.tsx`, `RecordDetailPanel.tsx`, `RecordDetailDrawer.tsx`, `LineItemsPanel.tsx`); the git tree at the head and a read-only grep of the local checkout served only to locate candidates and the landed CHANGELOG precedent. Nothing was built, run or re-run.

**Check-runs on the head (the gate verdicts):** 33 check-runs, all completed at 09:22Z: 30 `success`, 3 `skipped` by design (`Test (coverage)`, the coverage-shard template, `dependabot`), 0 failed, 0 in progress. Green among them: `Type Check`, `Lint`, `Test (shard 1..12/12)`, `Test (dist pins)`, `Build & E2E`, `Repo Gates`, `Spec Main Shape Gate`, `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Claim Re-read`, `Changeset Bump Policy`, `Changeset Fixed Group Check`, `Changeset Overwrite Report`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Line Citation Gate`, `Build Docs`, `Bundle Analysis`.

### ① Derived judgments

**Published surfaces, measured at the head.**

- `@object-ui/plugin-detail` `package.json`: `exports` holds only `"."` (`dist/index.js`, `dist/index.umd.cjs`, `dist/index.d.ts`); `files` is `dist`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `LICENSE`. The barrel `src/index.tsx` at the head exports no name from `recordPageProvenance.ts`: `RecordPageProvenanceContext` is reachable through neither the entry nor any subpath (there is none), so it is module-internal as declared. `RecordMetaFooter` and `RecordMetaFooterProps` were already exported (unchanged). `DetailViewProps` and `DetailViewSchema` gain nothing. **Right: nothing widens.**
- `@object-ui/app-shell` `package.json`: `exports` holds `"."` and `"./styles.css"`; `src/index.ts` is not in the diff. `RecordDetailView` and `PagePreview` gain no prop; the one new import is `RecordMetaFooter` from plugin-detail. **Right: nothing widens.**
- Accept sets: no spec key, no `DetailViewSchema` key, no `record:details` prop, no `DetailView` prop. Triage's ⛔ held. `isElementDataSourceConfig` is read, not changed.

**The narrowing claimed under `Clause-②: no` is true.** `DetailView` (published) now draws its `RecordMetaFooter` only when `RecordPageProvenanceContext` reads its default `false`. The one provider of `true` is `RecordDetailsBody` in `renderers/record-details.tsx`, around the one `DetailView` it mounts, with value `!isElementDataSourceConfig(schema.dataSource)`. That is byte-for-byte the predicate `isBound` in `renderers/recordBinding.tsx` reads (line 123 at the head), so the node the binding gate treats as unbound is exactly the node that reads the page's record: no node can be judged bound by one and unbound by the other. Everything else reads `false` and keeps its footer: the `detail-view` node (`DetailViewRenderer`, barrel line 282), `RecordDetailPanel` (and `RecordDetailDrawer`, which mounts the panel), and any direct React caller. The context cannot leak into a nested `DetailView`: the schema `record:details` synthesizes carries no `tabs`, `header`, `footer` or `relatedLists` slot, and every in-repo `RecordDetailPanel` or `RecordDetailDrawer` mount (ObjectGrid, ObjectKanban, ObjectCalendar, ObjectGantt, ObjectTree, ObjectDataTable) sits beside a `record:details` node, never under one. **Right.** A bound `record:details` keeps its own footer because its `DetailView` sits inside `BoundRecordProvider`'s own `RecordContextProvider` with value `false`: that is the record the page does not show. **Right, and pinned.**

**Every in-repo host that mounts a record context and renders `record:details` nodes.** At the head, `RecordContextProvider` is mounted as JSX in exactly three files under `packages/**` and `apps/**` (`SchemaRenderer`'s `record` page renderer, `LineItemsPanel`, `useFilterScope` and `filter-tokens` read the context and mount none; `studio-canvas-preview.tsx` renders object grids, not record pages):

1. `@object-ui/app-shell` `RecordDetailView` (runtime record page; the card's measured producer path): **exactly one.** The host footer sits in the single return branch that renders the page tree (one `SchemaRenderer` at line 3565, the footer at 3617), inside the same `RecordContextProvider` and scroll container, after the approvals, permission-set and attachments appends and before `InlineEditSaveBar`; the early returns (loading, read failure, not found) render no page tree. Its `data` is `readablePageRecord`, the same FLS-filtered row the provider hands every block (line 3398); the old `DetailView` footer merged the inline-edit draft and the host's does not, and since audit fields are never editable that is not observable. `RecordMetaFooter` returns `null` without a created or updated value, so a record with no audit field draws nothing, as before. The three console mounts of this host (`apps/console/src/AppContent.tsx`, `record-header-preview.tsx`, `dev/DevRecordHeaderActions.tsx`) inherit the one footer. Pinned by `RecordDetailView.oneProvenanceFooter-12307.test.tsx` (assigned page with three nodes: one footer, held by no node; the all-hidden node has empty text; the synthesized default page has one).
2. `@object-ui/app-shell` `PagePreview`, preview and outline modes (`withRecordBinding` around `SchemaRenderer`): **exactly one.** The footer is gated on `recordObject && selectedRecord`, which is precisely the condition under which `withRecordBinding` mounts the record context; with no sample record there is no context, the nodes' binding gate draws its placeholder, and no footer question arises. Not pinned by a test (flag ③.11).
3. `@object-ui/app-shell` `PagePreview`, design mode with the `regions` shape (`withRecordBinding` around `PageBlockCanvas`): **none — a host left with none, named here as a regression.** `BlockLivePreview` renders every block through the real `SchemaRenderer` under `PreviewModeProvider` inside the sample-record context, so each `record:details` block's `DetailView` reads `true` and draws no footer, and the canvas draws none. Before this head the canvas drew one per block (the same duplicated line the card measured). Disposition in ③.10.
4. `@object-ui/plugin-detail` `BoundRecordProvider` (`renderers/recordBinding.tsx`, the bound record-block scope): a bound `record:details` draws **exactly one, its own record's.** Pinned.

No plugin, `packages/mobile`, `packages/runner` or console file mounts a record context otherwise.

**Other published behaviour.** An all-hidden unbound `record:details` now renders its wrapper `div`s and nothing inside them (no text, no border, shadow or card): triage's pin "draws no block" holds; the residual `space-y-4` slot is a margin, addressed in ③.7. The new module is reachable from the barrel through `DetailView.tsx` and `record-details.tsx`, so `check:unreferenced-sources` (part of the green `Type Check` job) is satisfied.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/12307-one-provenance-footer.md` declares `@object-ui/plugin-detail: minor` and `@object-ui/app-shell: minor`. Both packages sit in the one `fixed` group of `.changeset/config.json`, where `major` is refused by `check-changeset-no-major` (`Changeset Bump Policy`, green). The rule: `(narrowing)` is BREAKING, and objectui's own breaking changes ship as `minor` with the break stated in the body (AGENTS.md version alignment). The landed precedent in `packages/plugin-detail/CHANGELOG.md` for a published rendered-output narrowing is `17.7.0` under `### Minor Changes`: the activity-feed entry ("Behaviour change on the console record page (breaking in the objectui sense, shipped minor)") and the two "Behaviour change, deliberately narrowing" entries where a column or entry stops rendering. **`minor` is the right level for both packages and matches what the diff publishes.**
- The changeset body states the behaviour change for an external host that mounts `RecordContextProvider` and renders `record:details`, with the remedy (render `RecordMetaFooter` once with the record as `data` and the object definition as `objectSchema`): that is the text an upgrading host greps, and it matches the diff. It does not spell the word BREAKING nor carry a `Clause-②` line, which this repository's precedent for the same class does (`.changeset/11674-shortcuts-dialog-wired-only.md`, `.changeset/12055-upload-path-not-scope.md`: "BREAKING … minor under this repository's release model" plus `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`). Wording flag, not a level error.
- PR body `Clause-②: no`: right in its half. Nothing published widens (① above). The `(narrowing)` arm is omitted although the claim's own reason, the diff and this record all name a narrowing; the rule makes the arm optional ("at most one arm") and `Changeset Declaration`, `Changeset Claim Re-read` and `Changeset Bump Policy` are green on this head, so this is a flag to the seat (③.12), not a failure. This record is the contract-tier review the claim said a narrowing owes before the queue.

### ③ Boundary flags

Each entry of the os-dev-report's `deviations` and `out_of_scope_findings`, answered:

1. **Fence: `PagePreview.tsx` outside the claim's surface.** Necessary, not scope creep: it is the Studio's second record-page host, and without it the preview would have been a host left with none. Accepted.
2. **Fence: `recordPageProvenance.ts`.** A module-internal context in its own file, not exported; keeps `DetailView.tsx` exporting components only. Accepted.
3. **Fence: plugin-detail `README.md`.** The docs commandment; the section matches the diff (page owns the footer, bound node keeps its own, how an own host draws it). Accepted.
4. **Gate 2 narrowed locally (155 app-shell files + 4 console files).** The head's CI farm is the verdict: `Test (shard 1..12/12)` and `Test (dist pins)` all `success`. Answered.
5. **ESLint narrowed to the changed files.** `Lint` on the head: `success`. Answered.
6. **Ablation A's first two runs NOT MEASURED (lock queue timeout), later runs measured, both ablations with restore proofs.** Taken as reported; not re-run here (read-only). The pins they turned red are the ones triage asked for. Answered.
7. **Residual `space-y-4` slot of an all-hidden node (noted, not filed).** Triage's pin is "draws no block" and nothing is drawn: the pin holds. What remains is a margin in the region, which is polish; if the maintainer sees a doubled gap on cloud's environment page it is a follow-up card (section visibility computed before render), not a re-judge of this one. Accepted as a noted residual.
8. **Placement: the footer moves from inside the Details tab to the page foot on every default record page, below the discussion feed, visible on every tab (noted, not filed).** Judged against triage's direction: triage ruled the footer is the record page's, drawn once, landing in `DetailView.tsx` and the record-page host, and ruled out any authored switch; it set no placement. The page foot is where this host already appends its page-level chrome (approvals fallback, permission-set assignments, attachments fallback), and a page-level line that does not move with the active tab is the property triage's "one record, one footer" implies. The alternative "after the last `record:details` node" would need a page-scoped registry through a published context, a widening triage ruled out. **Within direction; not escalated.** A different placement, if the maintainer wants one after seeing it, is a new card.
9. **Commit trailers and zero label writes.** Not contract matters; noted.

Reviewer's own flags:

10. **Studio design canvas left with no footer (①.3).** A regression on an in-repo host: `PageBlockCanvas` under `withRecordBinding` renders the real blocks under the sample-record context and draws no page chrome, so it went from one footer per block to none. It is disclosed in the PR body's Acceptance notes ("Studio design canvas") but absent from the os-dev-report's `deviations` and `out_of_scope_findings`, which is a reporting gap. Disposition: not blocking. The canvas is the block-editing surface and already omits every other page-level append (header actions, save bar, approvals and attachments fallbacks); the Studio's page-as-rendered surface (preview mode) draws the one footer; the card's measured producer is the runtime page, which is correct and pinned. If the maintainer wants canvas parity, it is one line: draw `RecordMetaFooter` under the canvas's last region inside `withRecordBinding`, as the preview branch does. Escalated to the seat as a candidate follow-up, not as a defect of this head.
11. **`PagePreview` preview-mode footer is unpinned.** The PR's tests cover `RecordDetailView` and the renderer; nothing pins that the Studio preview draws exactly one. Not blocking: the code path is the same component under the same condition as the record binding, and the preview is not the card's producer. Candidate follow-up.
12. **`Clause-②` arm.** The PR body's line reads `Clause-②: no` without the `(narrowing)` arm, and the changeset body carries neither the BREAKING word nor a `Clause-②` line, against the repository's precedent for this class (②). The gates accept the spelling; this record names the narrowing so the queue reads it as one. The seat may ask the dev to add the arm and the word before merge; not required for the verdict.
